mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supp_settlement_invoice (id, tenant_id, supp_settlement_id, invoice_id, create_time, delete_by, delete_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{suppSettlementId}, #{invoiceId}, now(), null, null, 0)
mapper.update: update supp_settlement_invoice set is_deleted = 1, delete_by = #{auditDeleteBy}, delete_by_name = #{auditDeleteByName}, delete_time = now() where supp_settlement_id = #{suppSettlementId} and invoice_id = #{invoiceId} and tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (delete_by is null or delete_by = '')
mapper.select: select id, tenant_id, supp_settlement_id, invoice_id, create_time, delete_by, delete_time from supp_settlement_invoice where IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 AND supp_settlement_id = #{suppSettlementId} and tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (delete_by is null or delete_by = '') order by create_time
